name: Leica Q2
description: Leica Q2 数码相机。技术参数依据厂家规格表或官方说明书整理，具体模式及测试条件可通过逐项来源查阅。

rows.label: 传感器类型与像素
rows.value: 全画幅 CMOS 传感器；总像素 5040 万，有效像素 4730 万
rows.originalValue: 全画幅 CMOS 传感器, 50.4/47.3 百万像素 (总像素/有效像素)

rows.label: 色彩深度
rows.originalValue: 14 bit

rows.label: DNG / JPEG 分辨率
rows.originalValue: JPEG: Zoom 28 mm: 47 mega像素 (8368x5584 像素), 24 mega像素 (6000x4000 像素), 12 mega像素 (4271x2848 像素) Zoom 35 mm: 30 mega像素 (6704x4472 像素), 15 mega像素 (4800x3200 像素), 8 mega像素 (3424x2288 像素) Zoom 50 mm: 15 mega像素 (4688x3128 像素), 8 mega像素 (3360x2240 像素), 4 mega像素 (2400x1600 像素) Zoom 75 mm: 7 mega像素 (3136x2096 像素), 3 mega像素 (2240x1496 像素), 2 mega像素 (1600x1072 像素) DNG: Zoom 28 mm: 46,7 mega像素 (8368x5584 像素)

rows.label: 色彩空间
rows.originalValue: sRGB / Adobe RGB / ECI RGB V.2.0

rows.label: JPEG 风格
rows.value: 标准、鲜艳、自然、单色、高对比度单色；各模式可将对比度、饱和度和锐度调节 5 挡
rows.originalValue: Standard, Vivid, Natural, Monochrome, Monochrome High Contrast, all with additional settings for contrast, saturation, and sharpness in 5 steps

rows.label: 镜头系统
rows.value: Leica Summilux 28 f/1.7 ASPH.；9 组 11 片，含 3 片非球面镜片
rows.originalValue: Leica Summilux 28 f/1.7 ASPH., 11 elements in 9 groups, 3 aspherical elements

rows.label: 防抖
rows.value: 照片和视频均支持光学防抖
rows.originalValue: Optical compensation system for photo and video recordings

rows.label: 光圈范围
rows.originalValue: 1.7 to 16 in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 对焦距离
rows.originalValue: 30 cm to ∞, with macro setting from 17 cm

rows.label: 对焦方式
rows.value: 自动或手动对焦；手动对焦可启用放大和峰值辅助
rows.originalValue: Automatic (autofocus) or manual focusing, option of magnifying function and edge marking (focus peaking) available for manual setting

rows.label: 自动对焦系统
rows.originalValue: Contrast-based autofocus system

rows.label: 自动对焦模式
rows.value: AFS（合焦后释放快门）、AFC（随时可释放快门）；可保存自动对焦设置
rows.originalValue: AFS (shutter release only after successful focusing), AFC (shutter release possible at any time), AF setting can be saved

rows.label: 自动对焦测量方式
rows.value: 单区（225 区）、多区、人脸识别、主体追踪
rows.originalValue: Single zone (225 fields), multi-field, face recognition, subject tracking

rows.label: OLED 取景器
rows.value: OLED，1280×960 像素×3 色（约 368 万点），视野约 100%，4:3；眼点 21 mm，屈光度 −4 至 +3；眼传感器自动切换取景器和显示屏
rows.originalValue: Resolution: 1280 × 960 像素 x 3 colors (=3.68 MP), image field: 约 100%, aspect ratio: 4:3, eye distance: 21mm adjustable -4 - +3 diopters, with eye sensor for automatic switching between viewfinder and monitor

rows.label: 显示屏
rows.value: 3 英寸 TFT 液晶触摸屏，约 104 万像素
rows.originalValue: 3" TFT LCD monitor with 约 1,040,000 像素, touch control possible

rows.label: ISO 范围
rows.originalValue: Automatic, ISO 50, ISO 100, ISO 200, ISO 400, ISO 800, ISO 1600, ISO 3200, ISO 6400, ISO 12500, ISO 25000, ISO 50000

rows.label: 白平衡
rows.value: 自动；日光、阴天、卤素灯、阴影、电子闪光预设；灰卡测量；手动色温
rows.originalValue: Automatic, default settings for: daylight, cloudy, halogen lighting, shadow, electronic flash, gray card, manual color temperature setting

rows.label: 曝光模式
rows.value: 程序自动、光圈优先、快门优先、手动曝光
rows.originalValue: Automatic program, aperture priority, shutter speed priority and manual setting

rows.label: 测光
rows.originalValue: Multi-field, center-weighted, spot

rows.label: 曝光补偿
rows.originalValue: ±3 EV in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 自动包围曝光
rows.value: 3 或 5 张，间隔最高 3 EV，1/3 EV 步长
rows.originalValue: 3 or 5 exposures in graduations of up to 3 EV, can be set in 1⁄3 EV increments

rows.label: 快门类型
rows.value: 可选机械、电子或混合快门
rows.originalValue: Optionally mechanical, electronical or hybrid

rows.label: 快门速度
rows.value: 机械快门 60–1/2000 秒；电子快门 1–1/40000 秒，1/3 挡步长；闪光同步最高 1/500 秒；兼容 HSS 的 SCA 3002 闪光灯可在快于 1/500 秒时使用线性闪光
rows.originalValue: 60 s to 1⁄2000 s with mech. Shutter, 1 s to 1⁄40000 s with electr. shutter, in 1⁄3 increments, flash synchronization up to 1⁄500 s, Linear flashes with all shutter speeds less than 1⁄ 500 s possible (with HSS-enabled SCA 3002 standard flash units)

rows.label: 相机类型
rows.value: 固定焦距全画幅数码便携相机
rows.originalValue: Digital 35 mm compact camera, fixed focal length

rows.label: 动态范围
rows.originalValue: 14 aperture stops at ISO 100

rows.label: 照片格式
rows.originalValue: Selectable: DNG, DNG + JPEG, JPEG

rows.label: 视频文件格式
rows.originalValue: MP4 (C4K / 4K / FullHD)

rows.label: 场景模式
rows.value: 全自动、运动、人像、风景、夜景人像、雪景／海滩、烟花、烛光、日落、望远镜摄影、微缩效果、全景、延时摄影
rows.originalValue: Fully automatic, sport, portrait, landscape, night portrait, snow/beach, fireworks, candlelight, sunset, digiscoping, miniature effect, panorama, time lapse

rows.label: 连拍速度
rows.value: 可选 10／5／3 张/秒（高／中／低速）
rows.originalValue: Selectable: 10/5/3 fps (H/M/L)

rows.label: 自拍定时
rows.originalValue: Delay time either 2 s or 12 s

rows.label: 存储介质
rows.originalValue: SD/SDHC/SDXC memory cards. Recommendation: UHS II memory cards

rows.label: 无线网络
rows.value: IEEE 802.11b/g/n 无线局域网；1–11 信道；WPA／WPA2 加密；基础设施模式
rows.originalValue: Satisfies IEEE 802.11b/g/n standard (standard WLAN protocol), channel 1-11, encryption method: WLAN-compatible WPA™/ WPA2™, access method: infrastructure mode

rows.label: 蓝牙
rows.originalValue: Bluetooth LE

rows.label: 电池续航
rows.originalValue: 约 350 (according to CIPA-standard)

rows.label: 机身材料
rows.value: 轻巧坚固的镁合金机身
rows.originalValue: Made of lightweight and robust magnesium construction
